snippet.title: Empyrion Galactic Survival - Update 1.9
snippet.description:
Main Features
- New game start: Ashon
- AI-vs-AI warfare
- New models for player avatars and weapons
- Reworked player armors
- Rebalanced weapons + added new weapons
- Added more context-related help info sources
- Added loads of new POI for various NPC factions

Find all the details about new features, additions and changes over here: https://www.empyriononline.com

---------

Empyrion - Galactic Survival is a 3D open world, space survival adventure in which you can fly across space and land on planets. Build, explore, fight and survive in a hostile galaxy full of hidden dangers. The game uniquely combines elements from space simulations, construction games, survival games and ego-shooters. The game is currently under development by Eleon Game Studios.

Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/383120
Forums: https://www.empyriononline.com
